messages:
anna_docs: Heads-up — opened a small docs PR to clarify region availability vs data residency. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482. It fixes a couple broken anchors and adds an SDK snippet for choosing regional endpoints.

mike_i18n: Thanks — will need strings for the new residency note. Can you add keys under `i18n/regions.json` so translators see context? e.g. `residency_notice_eu` and `residency_notice_us`

anna_docs: Yep adding keys now. Also found one broken link: docs/regions.md#eu -> docs/regions.md#europe has moved. I'll update and add a redirect note.

tyler_sdk: Quick glance at the snippet — please prefer this Node + Python minimal examples (small, copy-pastable). Suggest adding `region` + `residency` flags, and show fallback to private deployment. Example to include:
```js
// Node SDK example -- set region and residency hint
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'eu-west-1', residency: true });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'open-llama-70b', prompt: 'Hello' });
```
and Python: 
```py
# Python SDK
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'), region='eu-west-1', residency=True)
resp = client.generate(model='open-llama-70b', prompt='Hi')
```
Use small note: "residency: true requests data routing to region-specific controls; not a legal guarantee — see Private deployments for contractual guarantees."

sara_product: Important: legal asked that we avoid wording that implies hosted API guarantees residency. Use phrasing: "Customers requiring contractual data residency should use Redwood Private (VPC/on‑prem) or contact Sales for an enterprise contract." Add link to /private-deployments/ and legal review tag.

anna_docs: Good call. I'll change the sentence to that. Also plan to add an inline callout box with the short phrasing and link to Private.

deploy-bot: build/docs — FAILED 
--- output ---
Error: Link check failed: docs/regions.md#europe -> 404
See: https://deploy.ci/logs/12345
--- end ---

anna_docs: I pushed a fix for that anchor in the PR. Also removed an outdated list item that referenced "ap-south-1 (beta)" — we should avoid listing betas unless we have dates.

mike_i18n: For translations: also include a short context string `residency_context` that mentions "technical routing detail for docs team only" so translators don't translate as a legal claim.

tyler_sdk: One more SDK nit: update the Node snippet to use `region` value examples like `eu-west-1`, `us-central-1` not cloud provider names. People copy these literally. Add comment about fallback ordering: `region` -> `model-compat` -> `dedicated-pool`.

anna_docs: Assigning reviewers: @mike_i18n and @tyler_sdk. Targeting doc deploy tomorrow EOD. If legal needs to review, move timeline. Marking PR as `docs, i18n, sdk` and adding `needs-legal` label.

sara_product: I'll ping legal. If they approve wording by tomorrow noon, we can ship. Otherwise hold. :crossed_fingers:

anna_docs: Great — thanks all. I'll update PR with the revised copy and the SDK snippet per Tyler, add i18n keys, and fix the link. Will post back here when CI passes.

deploy-bot: build/docs — PASSED (after fixes) — https://deploy.ci/logs/12347

anna_docs: CI green. PR updated with notes for translators and a short changelog entry. Requesting final thumbs. :thumbsup:
